findings.observed_problem: Orca branch identity can drift from the intended remote carrier name.
findings.repeated_evidence: Parallel worker branches were pushed to mauedgar/... rather than the planned devlab/... refs.
findings.current_workaround: Reobserve the actual remote branch and compose exact commits by SHA.
findings.proposed_contract_delta: Before worker launch, assert local branch, intended remote ref, and push target correspondence; expose them in the launch receipt.

findings.observed_problem: Long inline terminal commands are fragile under layered quoting.
findings.repeated_evidence: Multiple terminal-send launch attempts failed or mangled quoting; pre-materialized short launcher paths succeeded.
findings.current_workaround: Materialize a bounded launcher and send only its path.
findings.proposed_contract_delta: Prefer argv/file-based launch bindings over nested shell strings.

findings.observed_problem: Candidate-only workflow_dispatch is constrained by GitHub default-branch workflow discovery.
findings.repeated_evidence: Direct dispatch of ts-exec-runner.yml failed while it was absent from main; reusable workflow invocation by exact SHA from the fixture caller succeeded.
findings.current_workaround: Use a reusable workflow called from a qualified fixture/default-branch caller.
findings.proposed_contract_delta: Treat reusable exact-SHA caller workflows as the preferred pre-adoption Actions qualification path.

findings.observed_problem: Artifact-only remote results require extra retrieval before semantic inspection.
findings.repeated_evidence: Adding TS_EXEC_SUMMARY exposed request identity, binding, status, effect state, digest and timing directly in durable job logs.
findings.current_workaround: Emit a compact validated summary plus keep full result/receipt artifacts.
findings.proposed_contract_delta: Standardize a compact execution-summary line for remote bindings while keeping artifacts canonical.
